components.name: Rider App
components.purpose: Requests rides and observes versioned trip state.

components.name: Driver App
components.purpose: Sends timestamped GPS updates and accepts fenced offers.

components.name: Location Service
components.purpose: Validates and expires latest driver positions.

components.name: Geospatial Index
components.purpose: Finds candidates in neighboring cells and filters stale locations.

components.name: Matching Service
components.purpose: Chooses eligible drivers and manages expiring offers.

components.name: ETA Service
components.purpose: Estimates road-based pickup times for candidates.

components.name: Trip Service
components.purpose: Owns assignment leases and legal trip transitions.

components.name: Database
components.purpose: Stores durable trips, assignments, payment intents and history.

components.name: Payment Service
components.purpose: Performs idempotent payment operations and reconciliation.

components.name: Event Queue
components.purpose: Carries durable trip events and optional telemetry work.

components.name: Notification Service
components.purpose: Sends ride offers and state-change hints; it is not a CDN.

tradeoffs.guidance: Any justified spatial index is acceptable; handle boundaries and stale data.
Prevent conflicting acceptance rather than promising safety from a cache lookup alone.
Explain latency versus utilization without requiring a proprietary algorithm.

dataModel.notes: Use conditional legal transitions and indexed user history.
Offer expiry is separate from durable accepted occupancy; terminal trip transitions release ownership conditionally.
Expiring latest state; not an append-only SQL trip field.
Idempotent requests and provider callbacks prevent double charging.

flows.name: Location to match
steps: Driver submits a timestamped GPS update
Location service updates the expiring spatial index
Matching service filters nearby eligible drivers and requests ETA
Trip service conditionally reserves the chosen driver with a lease
Acceptance validates the offer version and commits durable driver occupancy; only a terminal or reconciled transition releases it

flows.name: Completion
steps: Trip service conditionally marks a trip complete
A stable payment operation is sent or retried
Callbacks update the payment intent idempotently and reconciliation resolves uncertainty
